title: BMW Sales Performance Analytics
description: A vehicle-sales dashboard examining regional performance, trends, fuel mix, manufacturer comparisons and the relationship between mileage and price.
question: Which regions, vehicle attributes and time periods stand out in the analyzed sales dataset?
design: Placed revenue, units sold and average selling price across the top, with visual comparisons for sales by region, sales through time, market share and mileage-related pricing patterns. The dashboard presents the dataset; it is not an official BMW financial statement.
focus: Summary indicators establish a quick orientation
Time-series charts show directional changes in sales
Mileage-versus-price analysis exposes a relationship worth investigating
reflection: Sales visuals become more informative when volume, value, geography and product characteristics can be considered together.
coverAlt: Original BMW Sales Performance Analytics dashboard showing sales metrics, regional comparisons, trend lines, market-share bars and mileage versus selling price scatter plot
